title: Shared enums and common structures for the FSIE knowledge contract
description: Single source of truth for status machines, node keys and shared value domains. Asset schemas reference these via $ref. The Python module packages/contracts/enums.py must stay in sync; validate_fsie_package.py fails on drift.

ReleaseLevel.description: Product release level. L0 is the only 2026 default commitment.

LifecycleStatus.description: Knowledge-asset lifecycle (FSIE data plan s.2). Forward flow discovered->captured->parsed->candidate->machine_checked->human_review->verified->active; any stage may move to rejected/stale/blocked.

ProfessionalValidationStatus.description: Professional sign-off. Only a Hong Kong tax expert may move an asset to verified.

FactConfirmationStatus.description: Lifecycle of a single case fact (data plan s.3.5). The LLM may only write ai_candidate; advisor_confirmed is required before a fact feeds rule execution.

InlineFactSentinel.description: Reserved values allowed inside a candidate case's inline facts map when the business value is not asserted. Unknown must never be converted into a negative.

NodeOutputStatus.description: Per-node rule output. Missing facts map to unknown/condition_not_demonstrated, never to not_satisfied.

CaseTerminalState.description: Safe terminal states for an L0 synthetic case run.

BlockingLevel.description: How a fact gates the judgement chain: blocks scope, blocks a conclusion, or merely supports.

FactDomain.description: The eight fact domains of PRD FR-03.

JudgementNodeKey.description: Canonical keys for the ten-step FSIE judgement chain (PRD s.5.2) plus the cross-cutting human gate. ordinal 0 denotes the non-sequential gate.

Locator.description: Precise location of a legal unit inside its source.

Threshold.description: A candidate numeric/boolean threshold. Always unverified at L0 and bound to a legal unit once ingested.

statute_locator.description: Human citation such as s.15M(2), filled from the verified clause map.
